references.text: Moses conveyed the Lord's words to the people, who answered that they would obey everything the Lord had commanded – this shows how Moses gave the law to Israel.
Moses instructs Israel about the laws and statutes that the Lord has commanded, confirming his role as lawgiver.
This law was presented by Moses to the children of Israel, confirming that Moses gave the law as an inheritance to the assembly.
God's testimony is an eternal inheritance, reflecting the idea of the law as an inheritance for Jacob's assembly.
Joshua is reminded to hold fast to the law of Moses, showing how the law was passed from Moses to the people.
The law was given through Moses, while grace and truth came through Jesus Christ – this confirms Moses' role as lawgiver.
Stephen refers to Moses as the one who received living words on Mount Sinai to pass them on to Israel.
